name: chroma_denoise
what: non-local-means clean-up of the colour planes only (KNLMeansCL on the GPU); the luma, and with it every line, is untouched
when: flat areas show blotchy, crawling colour while the lines themselves are steady (tape chroma noise)
softens: small colour details (a thin coloured line can fade at strong)
tried_on: written from restoration practice; runs and passes the guard on a 15 s cut of an owner cartoon that does not show this defect (safe to try). Whether it helps on a source that has the defect is not shown yet
